_source: Blueprint F2 (opening, frame by frame) and F3 (false assumption line). 'see' and 'animation' are art/animation direction, not on-screen text.

frames.see: Rainy Veyra road, case file and lantern held from off-screen.
frames.narration: The file was ten years old. The village was still listed as a disappearance.
frames.animation: Slow rain; comic panel slides in.

frames.see: Elias sets the lantern down; face never shown.
frames.narration: Three ghosts were said to be trapped here. I thought that was the case.
Every clock in Veyra stopped at the same minute.
frames.animation: The hand twitches but never advances.

frames.narration: She looked at me as though she had been waiting for ten years.
frames.animation: Mira fades in; Elias remains off-frame.

frames.see: Black silhouette appears in a window reflection.
frames.narration: I had never been inside Veyra before. At least, that is what I remembered.
frames.animation: Reflection doubles for one beat, then clears.

frames.see: Village hub, three witnesses, clock tower and locked locations.
frames.narration: The case began with a missing village. It would end by asking who had erased it.

falseAssumption: I came here to investigate a ten-year-old disappearance.
